title: Send email with AutoSend
description: Send transactional email from an AutoSend template or your own HTML, and send AutoSend events that start automations.

environment.name: AUTOSEND_API_KEY
environment.description: A project API key, which starts with AS_, from your AutoSend project's API keys settings. Keep it on the server.

environment.name: AUTOSEND_FROM
environment.description: The default sender for /send-email, on a domain verified in AutoSend, for example Acme <hello@mail.example.com>. A request can set another sender in its from field.

environment.name: AUTOSEND_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Callers send this random token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. It must be at least 32 characters long, and openssl rand -hex 32 generates one. Neon Function URLs are public, so the function requires it.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: POST to, and either a templateId with optional dynamicData or a subject with html or text. The from and replyTo fields are optional.

operations.title: Send an AutoSend event
operations.description: POST an email or contactId, an eventName, and optional eventProperties to record an AutoSend event, which can start an automation.
